films.descriptionZh: 從石器時代到木星之旅，一段關於人性與進化的宏大科幻沉思。

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.descriptionZh: 本单元从本年电影节遴选六部短片，包括若干评审奖得主，呈现多样国际短片样貌。
films.descriptionEn: A curated selection of six standout short films from the festival program, including Jury Award winners, offering a cross‑section of nonfiction and narrative work from around the world compiled into a single tour program.

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Film Festival Short Film Tour
films.descriptionZh: 从本届圣丹斯影展遴选出的短片合集，呈现多样题材与导演视角。
films.descriptionEn: A curated program of short films drawn from this year’s Sundance Film Festival, gathering diverse voices and genres into a single showcase that highlights contemporary short filmmaking and emerging directors.

films.descriptionZh: 杨氏青春记忆中六〇年代台湾的黑帮、政治压抑与美国流行文化的交织图景。
Kubrick 的反乌托邦经典，35mm 放映并由 Rafer Guzmán 引介。
记录举重与健身文化，阿诺与费里尼在台上角逐雄壮体魄。
导演兼编舞者自述，描绘一位沉迷情欲与毒品的舞者的人生。
films.descriptionEn: Director-choreographer Bob Fosse frames an autobiographical tale through the sordid life of Joe Gideon, a womanizing, drug-using dancer whose career and personal excesses collide.

films.descriptionZh: 一部扑克脸式的伪纪录片，跟随技艺有限的年轻人辗转于电话推销、洗碗、工厂等低薪工作。
films.descriptionEn: A deadpan microbudget mockumentary that follows Randy Scott as he drifts through a series of menial minimum-wage jobs—telemarketer, dishwasher, factory hand, motel attendant—offering a bleakly comic portrait of American working life.

films.descriptionZh: 阿尔萨独自居住在海边破屋，三名年轻人到来打破寂静。
films.descriptionEn: Arsa, about eighteen, lives alone in a rundown hovel overlooking the sea on the edge of an island; when three youngsters arrive and rent a holiday home, their presence begins to change her isolated life.

films.descriptionZh: 1920年代洛杉矶群像故事，呈現好萊塢的奢靡與衰落。
films.descriptionEn: An original epic set in 1920s Los Angeles following multiple characters whose outsized ambition and excess chart rises and falls during an era of unbridled decadence and depravity in early Hollywood.

films.descriptionZh: 少年誤入時光機回到1955年，必須促成父母相愛才能回到1985年。
films.descriptionEn: A 17-year-old accidentally travels back to 1955 in a time machine and must set about getting his parents to fall in love again as the only way to return to 1985.

films.descriptionZh: 由巴巴拉·哈默档案与访谈拼贴而成，呈现她的创作与晚年。
爱尔兰青年巴里改名改命，沉浮于18世纪欧洲的军旅、间谍與赌局之间，最终难以赢得真正的接纳。
films.descriptionEn: Redmond Barry leaves Ireland after a fatal duel and pursues fortune across 18th-century Europe as a soldier, spy, and gambler; he marries into aristocracy for wealth but ultimately finds the acceptance he seeks eludes him.

films.descriptionZh: 複雜未來城中，獵人德卡德受命追緝幾名逃回地球的複製人。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where engineered humans serve as laborers, a retired Blade Runner is tasked with hunting four replicants who have returned to Earth and begun killing; a dark, atmospheric hunt that questions what it means to be human.

films.descriptionZh: 1970年代，少年因天賦成為成人影壇明星，夢想與現實交鋒。
films.descriptionEn: Set in 1977, a teenager discovers a talent that propels him to celebrity as an adult entertainer while a family of filmmakers tries to redefine the adult industry amid disco, drugs, and shifting fashions.

films.descriptionZh: 教授在古老档案中追踪疑似被梵蒂冈掩盖的时间观看装置，走入文字与阴谋的迷宫。
两个失恋警察、菠萝罐头与加州梦交织的香港情书。
films.descriptionEn: A pop-infused, bifurcated tale of two lovelorn cops and the women who baffle them, told in a sensorial, richly stylized mode that invites the viewer to sink into a world equal parts vivid, bittersweet, and heartbreakingly intimate.

films.canonicalTitle: Cinema Tehran Presents: Cairo Station + Orderly or Disorderly
films.displayTitle: Cinema Tehran Presents: Cairo Station + Orderly or Disorderly

films.descriptionZh: 珀尔修斯与众神怪物交锋，奇幻與英雄史詩並行。
生物教授在生物科技大会爆发变异病毒，困在会场与幸存者奋战。
一次严重车祸将导演引入以车祸为性刺激的地下亚文化，揭示死亡与欲望的纠缠。
films.descriptionEn: After a severe car crash, a TV director discovers an underground subculture of scarred, omnisexual crash victims who eroticize auto collisions, exploring how danger, death, and sexual obsession intertwine.

films.descriptionZh: 一次车祸将几人带入以血与碎玻璃为欲望对象的恋物与死亡地下世界。
films.descriptionEn: After a collision, a disaffected producer and an enigmatic doctor are drawn, along with the producer’s wife, into a kinky, death-obsessed underworld of car-crash fetishists for whom twisted metal and scar tissue become erotic triggers.

films.canonicalTitle: Critics & Filmmakers: A Conversation between Godfrey Cheshire & Alex Winter
films.displayTitle: Critics & Filmmakers: A Conversation between Godfrey Cheshire & Alex Winter

films.canonicalTitle: Day Night Day Night - 35MM + Q&A | 2006 Movies
films.displayTitle: Day Night Day Night - 35MM + Q&A | 2006 Movies

films.canonicalTitle: Days and Nights in the Forest
films.displayTitle: Days and Nights in the Forest
films.descriptionZh: 四名中產青年郊遊卻被各自種姓偏見與情感困境逼迫面對自身缺陷。
films.descriptionEn: Four middle‑class young men leave crowded Calcutta for a rustic holiday in the Palamau woods, bringing caste and gender prejudices with them; expecting fleeting romance, they instead must confront their own boorish biases and shortcomings.

films.descriptionZh: 末世城市中，一位失业小丑发现肉铺背后隐秘又黑暗的真相。
films.descriptionEn: In a post-apocalyptic cityscape, an unemployed circus clown discovers unsettling secrets at a butcher’s shop that has turned to cannibalism, a darkly comic, stylized debut rendered in burnished gold hues.

films.descriptionZh: 三名炸弹少年卷入黑帮与暴力，怒火般的反叛宣泄全片。
一名自信商人謀殺情人丈夫，引發一連串不幸事件。
films.descriptionEn: A self‑assured businessman murders his employer—the husband of his mistress—which unintentionally sets off an ill‑fated chain of events.

films.descriptionZh: 音樂影像化再現伊娃·裴隆的奢華崛起與落幕。
films.descriptionEn: A lavish, visually driven musical adaptation that traces Eva Perón’s meteoric rise and tragic end, staging grand crowd scenes and constant costume changes to recreate her public ascent and its dramatic resonance.

films.descriptionZh: 17岁的Isabel在豪华高尔夫度假村当“发球女孩”，暗藏等级与暴力的阴影逐渐浮现。
在1897到1912年的岁月里，记者阿尔维德与莉迪亚的爱恋因野心与家变而错失，弥漫着悔恨与未竟的选择。
和平之地遭机械军团袭击，人民被石化，众人寻因。
films.descriptionEn: In a distant world, a peace‑loving civilization faces a merciless army of automata that turns its people to stone; a council of matriarchs sends brave seekers to discover the source of the Men of Metal and confront their destiny.

films.canonicalTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.displayTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.descriptionZh: 2029年，半机械化的少校追踪一个在信息海洋中诞生的神秘存在。
films.descriptionEn: In 2029 a cyborg Major tracks an omnipotent entity born in a sea of information—an ambiguous hacker or virus threatening world order—while the animation blends hand-drawn and CGI techniques to render her physical and existential journey.

films.descriptionZh: 王家卫以布宜诺斯艾利斯为背景拍一段反复破裂的爱情。
films.descriptionEn: Two lovers, expatriates in Buenos Aires, navigate the waning days of their relationship against lusty tango bars, bustling sidewalks, and a hypnotic visit to Iguazu Falls, a vivid, stylistic study of love on the brink of dissolution.

films.descriptionZh: 一位執著偵探與一名聰明竊賊因一宗高風險證券劫案交織命運。
films.descriptionEn: An obsessive detective and a brilliant thief find their fates intertwined in the aftermath of a high-stakes securities heist, setting up a taut psychological drama between cat and mouse.

films.descriptionZh: 讽刺又辛辣的校园黑色喜剧，毒舌与暗黑笑料交织。
films.descriptionEn: A cynical, surreal dark high‑school comedy that masks sharper themes beneath gleefully nasty putdowns and iconic performances; its bitter humor and memorable lines have made it one of the most influential teen films in modern times.

films.canonicalTitle: Hell’s Highway: The True Story of Highway Safety Films | Sex, Death, Cars!
films.displayTitle: Hell’s Highway: The True Story of Highway Safety Films | Sex, Death, Cars!
films.descriptionZh: 本片发掘1959–1979年间以血腥驾驶画面警示学生的高速公路安全教育片，重现其震撼教化手法。
英雄杰森远航觅金羊毛，途中对抗巨人、蛇形九头兽与骷髅兵等怪物。

films.canonicalTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.displayTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.descriptionZh: 围绕对作家萨尔曼·鲁西迪的刺杀未遂及其背景展开。

films.canonicalTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie (Open Captioning)

films.descriptionZh: 伪造牛仔裤牵出黑帮、CIA与爆炸装置，一场荒诞的动作冒险。
布列松用一张假钞追踪偶然如何一路酿成悲剧。
巴黎郊区三位青年在骚乱后的一天，怒火不断逼近爆点。
年长诗人被年轻崇拜者重新发现，虚荣与旧梦随之苏醒。
勞倫斯在沙漠中聯合阿拉伯部落，掀起對奧斯曼帝國的戰爭與身世探索。
films.descriptionEn: A sweeping biography traces an enigmatic desert-loving Englishman who unites Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Turks during World War I, presenting a complex portrait of his character and deeds.

films.descriptionZh: 單親母與兩女返台開夜市，隱秘的裂縫逐漸顯露。

films.canonicalTitle: Leonora in the Morning Light + Q&A
films.displayTitle: Leonora in the Morning Light + Q&A
films.descriptionZh: 画家莱奥诺拉·卡灵顿反抗社会期待，投身超现实主义并在墨西哥找到自我力量。
films.descriptionEn: Painter Leonora Carrington rebels against social expectations, joins the surrealist circle in Paris amid a tumultuous romance, confronts inner demons, and eventually flees to Mexico where she finds empowerment.

films.descriptionZh: 社交名媛莱蒂为逃离占有欲强的情人而投向富有美国人的怀抱，随之而来的是受一桩19世纪苏格兰丑闻启发的情感与法律风波。
荒原中，孤獨的瑪克斯與一群倖存者駕駛戰車逃離暴君追捕。
films.descriptionEn: Haunted by his past, a lone wanderer becomes swept up with survivors fleeing across the Wasteland in a war rig driven by Furiosa as they escape a tyrannical Citadel and face a relentless pursuit.

films.descriptionZh: 美食网红的成功压力唤醒她极力压下的过往。
films.descriptionEn: A plucky dishwasher at a trendy food content company leaps to viral superstardom, enjoying an adoring husband and devoted best friend, even as mounting pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her past.

films.descriptionZh: 残酷的科西里克家族掳走主教候选人，玛尔凯塔被夺走，十三世纪波希米亚的信仰冲突与暴力交织成史诗。
帕索里尼以梅黛亚为象征，讲述被抛弃的女巫因骗局而走向复仇的悲剧。
讲述南中洛杉矶一位男子在兄弟婚礼与好友葬礼之间的艰难抉择。
Gregg Araki 以两段破碎记忆直视创伤与自我认知。
一位富有航运大亨去世后，亲戚们被迫共同管理遗产，久藏的怨恨与秘密逐一浮出。
片中如手记般思绪流动，准备在非洲拍摄改编古希腊悲剧。
从神话出发，讲述无知的命运将一人推入与母亲的悲剧纠葛。
films.descriptionEn: A reworking of Sophocles’ tragedy that begins with a prologue in prewar Italy and follows Oedipus as an unwitting victim of his own ignorance, staged with color, stylized costumes, and an almost science-fiction vision of the ancient world.

films.descriptionZh: 一名职场小白领因催眠事件“放任自流”，意外被提拔并反讽企业文化。
艺术家K8 Hardy用迷你摄像机记录日常造型，成为成长与时尚编码的档案。
films.descriptionEn: Artist-filmmaker K8 Hardy filmed her daily outfits on a small MiniDV camera over years, creating a record of how a young lesbian feminist dressed and styled during her coming-of-age and an examination of coded fashion statements.

films.descriptionZh: 梦境记录技术外泄，潜意识影像与现实交织威胁城市秩序。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where therapists can record dreams with the DC Mini, the theft of a prototype causes subconscious images to bleed into reality, sparking a race to prevent a psychedelic dream apocalypse on the streets.

films.descriptionZh: 以1913年脆弱的民国为背景，三位倔强女性在戏曲、权力与情爱间交织冒险。
films.descriptionEn: Set in fragile Republican-era China, three irrepressible women—a would-be Peking Opera star, a warlord’s daughter, and a jewel-thief courtesan—collide in a fizzing mashup of espionage, screwball romance, slapstick, and costume spectacle.

films.descriptionZh: 一個孩子在森林中遇見一位神秘女孩，獲得與母親及亡祖母連結的機會。

films.canonicalTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY
films.displayTitle: PRIVATE EVENT TODAY IN THEATER & COMMISSARY

films.descriptionZh: 车库摇滚乐队的贝斯手遇上滑板女孩，却要面对她的一群前任追逐者。
films.descriptionEn: As the bass player in a garage‑rock band, Scott Pilgrim falls for Ramona Flowers, only to discover she carries an army of vengeful ex‑boyfriends who challenge him in increasingly literal, comic‑book‑style battles.

films.descriptionZh: 两位侦探在一座潮湿破败的城市追踪手法极端的连环杀手。
films.descriptionEn: A nearing-retirement detective and his newcomer partner track a serial killer with theatrical methods through a perpetually sodden, decaying city, confronting gruesome crimes and moral collapse.

films.descriptionZh: 一位刚出院的羞怯女子在律师办公室里与雇主发展出虐恋关系。
films.descriptionEn: A timid young woman recently released from a mental hospital takes a job as a secretary to a demanding lawyer; their employer‑employee dynamic evolves into a complex sexual, sadomasochistic relationship that reshapes both of their lives.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎，丧女父亲与神秘精神科医展开追凶复仇之路，正义与执念模糊。
films.descriptionEn: A grieving father and a mysterious psychiatrist embark on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his daughter is murdered, abducting and interrogating suspects across Paris as the line between justice and obsession begins to blur.

films.canonicalTitle: Shakedown + Q&A | JT Selects: Club Films
films.displayTitle: Shakedown + Q&A | JT Selects: Club Films

films.descriptionZh: 以戰火為背景的絢麗諧趣愛情歌舞，兩人在炸彈轟炸下約定十年重逢，命運巧合又荒誕。
小偷赴南美叢林與同夥運送硝化甘油，與大自然展開生死角力。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑time crook from Brooklyn joins fellow hard‑luck men in the sweltering South American jungle to haul nitroglycerine, turning a perilous job into a bleak, elemental confrontation between humans and nature.

films.descriptionZh: 司機試圖掩蓋邊緣家庭的謀殺與食人行徑，既黑色又荒誕。
十九岁的露西前往托斯卡纳别墅，追寻母亲踪迹与初吻的回忆，同时面对众多追求者。
Talking Heads现场影像，三夜同场录制，影史经典演唱会电影。
films.descriptionEn: A landmark concert film capturing Talking Heads over three nights at Hollywood’s Pantages Theatre, featuring David Byrne and the band in a dynamic live performance.

films.descriptionZh: 一位父亲在城市荒凉中为孩子勉强维生，超市里孩子们寻找保护。
films.descriptionEn: A minimalist portrait of urban desolation: a single father ekes out a subsistence living as a human signboard while his hungry children spend their days in a supermarket, where they encounter a protector in the store manager.

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.descriptionZh: 一位年轻导演前往拜访退隐的原片女星，兩人陷入充滿慾望與恐懼的血腥世界，面對重生與自我實現的試煉。
films.descriptionEn: A young director aiming to revive a camp slasher franchise visits the original film’s reclusive star; their encounter pulls both women into a surreal, bloody world of desire, fear, and delirium under threat from the menacing Little Death.

films.descriptionZh: 一名商人误杀“金属崇拜者”，随后被慢慢改造成肉与锈铁的怪异混合体。
films.descriptionEn: A businessman accidentally kills a Metal Fetishist and is gradually transformed into a grotesque hybrid of flesh and rusted metal, plunging into a bizarre, cyberpunk tale of revenge and bodily metamorphosis.

films.descriptionZh: 一个为上司当情人住所的纽约小职员，在孤独与苦乐之间搅拌出酸涩喜剧。
films.descriptionEn: An anxious insurance employee lets his boss use his small Manhattan apartment as a rendezvous spot while he courts an elevator operator, a bittersweet comedy-drama set against boozy office parties and caustic holiday cheer.

films.descriptionZh: 锻刀匠为父亲的死展开复仇之旅，动作影像充满狂热与暴力美学。

films.canonicalTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.displayTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai

films.descriptionZh: 圣诞夜的邪恶圣诞老人入侵，带来迷离雾都中被掳儿童夢境被掠奪的奇幻冒險。
films.descriptionEn: After a Christmas Eve invasion by sinister Santas, a boy wanders a fog-shrouded harbor city of freaks and carnies as a desiccant cult leader harvests kidnapped children’s dreams, an eerie, atmospheric fairy tale.

films.descriptionZh: 一对中年夫妇邀请楼上年轻夫妇聚会，意外发展改变了当晚。
films.descriptionEn: A middle-aged couple invites the younger, livelier pair upstairs for a get-together that unexpectedly upends both relationships, exposing emotional costs and prompting wincing laughs of recognition.

films.descriptionZh: 蔚蓝科西嘉岛上，少女莱西亚被带到父亲藏身的偏僻别墅。
films.descriptionEn: On a pale, sun‑soaked island of Corsica, teenage Lesia is taken from her sheltered life to a remote villa where her fugitive mob‑boss father is hiding, leaving her to confront a menacing and near‑strange figure who upends her world.

films.descriptionZh: 以轻快笔触改写安徒生，揭示小美人鱼的孤独與渴望。
films.descriptionEn: A sprightly take on Hans Christian Andersen’s tale, the film balances a hot crustacean band and a keening sense of angst and longing embodied in Ariel’s dream of being “Part of Your World,” supported by Menken and Ashman’s celebrated songs.

films.canonicalTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.displayTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.descriptionZh: 夜晚的京都奇遇记，少女在纵情狂欢中与形形色色人物相遇，展开荒诞一夜。
黑泽清的新作，以武士时代故事拆解忠诚与囚禁。
自由奔放的温蒂在与年长离异的杰克的关系中陷入抉择，旧爱回归让局势复杂化。
films.descriptionEn: Free-spirited Wendy finds herself at a crossroads in her relationship with an older divorced father, forcing both of them to confront change and where they go from here.

films.descriptionZh: 一名工程師失蹤後，後核烏lysses展開尋找新能量物質的荒誕航程。
印象派叙事下的中西部家庭，少年杰克在父子关系与信仰间探索人生。
films.descriptionEn: An impressionistic portrait of a Midwestern family in the 1950s, following eldest son Jack from childhood innocence to disillusioned adulthood as he struggles to reconcile a fraught relationship with his father and the search for meaning.

films.descriptionZh: 一只孤单的长臂猿在马来西亚城市中的消失森林里呼唤，团队争分夺秒赶去营救。
films.descriptionEn: A lone lar gibbon named Han calls from an isolated patch of forest wedged inside a Malaysian metropolis; cut off between highways, his plight spurs a team to race against time to reach him.

films.descriptionZh: 纽约帮派被诬陷后横穿全城返乡的夜行冒险。
一位年轻妇女回乡后遇到迷信与迫害，村中对女性展开镇压。
films.descriptionEn: Set in western Norway, a young woman returns to her village after a failed marriage to find the community gripped by superstitious panic and patriarchal efforts to persecute women accused of witchcraft.

films.descriptionZh: 两位错误归属的黑帮女友因身份被认错而引发混乱。
films.descriptionEn: Two codependent best friends, scraping by and passing the time bong to bong, are swept into chaos after a case of mistaken identity upends their lives, fueling a rambunctious stoner comedy about friendship and mayhem.

films.descriptionZh: 一位准父亲为糊口加入保镖行列，却卷入跨国犯罪與刺杀阴谋，动作爆裂。
一次童年车祸后，头骨植入钛板的模特亚历克西亚展开一段挑战身份与亲情的疯狂旅程。
films.descriptionEn: After a childhood car crash leaves a titanium plate fused to her skull, car model Alexia embarks on a wild, unpredictable journey that confronts assumptions about family, identity, and love.

films.descriptionZh: 年仅十九岁的安东尼·布尔丹在普罗温斯敦闯入餐厅厨房，度过塑造他人生的重要夏天。
films.descriptionEn: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, igniting a transformative summer that shapes the course of his life.

films.descriptionZh: 一位19岁的安东尼·布尔丹到普罗温斯敦，在餐厅厨房的混沌中度过改变一生的夏天。
films.descriptionEn: A nineteen-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, a summer that sets off experiences which shape the course of his life.

films.descriptionZh: 一位纽约钻石商沉迷赌局，命悬一线。
年轻人回到家乡，在家庭与阶层现实中重新定位自己。

films.canonicalTitle: Viva Las Vegas - 35MM + Learning from Learning from Las Vegas
films.displayTitle: Viva Las Vegas - 35MM + Learning from Learning from Las Vegas
films.descriptionZh: 赛车手来拉斯维加斯为赢得大奖与爱人展开角逐，也为赢回赌注留在城中。
films.descriptionEn: Race driver Lucky Jackson arrives in Las Vegas wanting money for a new engine and finds himself staying longer after meeting Rusty; when he loses his winnings, he must win back his money—and Rusty’s heart—while contending with a rival.

films.descriptionZh: 一位乡镇教师赴城途中误入酒馆，堕入荒诞与堕落之中。
改編羅密歐與茱麗葉，在紐約幫派鬥爭中上演經典愛情與舞蹈對抗。
films.descriptionEn: Two New York street gangs clash amid a modern reworking of Romeo and Juliet, as a doomed romance unfolds against 1950s gang warfare, set to an unforgettable score and exuberant choreography.

films.descriptionZh: 内向的白领执着拍摄“纪录片”，对新经理的痴迷逐渐演变为侵入式监视与危险行为。

films.canonicalTitle: Wings of Desire + Hidden in Pieces
films.displayTitle: Wings of Desire + Hidden in Pieces

films.descriptionZh: 三位旧同学在团聚后逃离家庭日常，重返奥斯陆街头与桑拿，畅谈欲望与遗憾。
films.descriptionEn: Three married former classmates reunite and, refusing to return immediately to domestic drudgery, take to Oslo’s streets and saunas while trading candid, often humorous conversations about sex, motherhood, regrets, and adult complications.

films.descriptionZh: 在奥斯陆街车上，为卡娅准备的50岁惊喜派对让三位老友展开充满回忆与未竟梦想的对话。
films.descriptionEn: A surprise 50th birthday on a city streetcar finds three old school friends revisiting deferred dreams, children coming of age, aging parents, and tangled romances against Oslo’s Independence Day backdrop.

films.descriptionZh: 十年后，三位旧友在马尔默酒店重聚，试图延续那场不羁的出逃与友情。

films.canonicalTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.displayTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.descriptionZh: 女配音員佩帕被情人拋棄，引發一連串誇張失控的情感與喜劇事件。
films.descriptionEn: Voice actress Pepa, abandoned by her lover, resolves to kill herself with gazpacho laced with sleeping pills—an act that kicks off a gaudy, cheeky screwball melodrama of unhinged behavior, emotional excess, and tangled relationships.

films.descriptionZh: 觀察台北中產三代情感生活的溫柔長片。
films.descriptionEn: A gentle, restrained study of three generations in an upper‑middle‑class Taipei family, shifting between comic foibles and a pervasive melancholy to explore missed opportunities and the hidden emotional spaces of everyday life.

films.descriptionZh: 讲述1972年多伦多一台戏如何催生北美喜剧新潮，演员回忆趣事与影响。
整场比赛中，镜头紧随齐达内的每一瞬，呈现赛场上专注与瞬间的力量。
